se.note: Approximate idle-only landmarks. Translation-only midpoint/front or visible-near-grip/rear. Zero residual for one point is arithmetic, not proof of physical contact. Same transform for all five phases; no frame fit or per-phase hand anchoring.

target_selection.method: Bounded least-squares against two manually annotated existing shaft segments, using idle grips only. Same actor transform for all five phases; no per-frame contact fitting.
